summary: A doctor countersigns a death certificate under a colleague's veiled threat, dismisses the widow, trades a wordless standoff with the priest, and files the new death beside the twenty-year-old one it mirrors — the cabinet scene earns its place, but several explanatory asides and a summarizing closing line keep telling the reader what the silence has already shown.

issues.unit: obwohl Stettler sie hätte lesen können
issues.fix_hint: Cut 'obwohl Stettler sie hätte lesen können'. Feuz reading the report aloud already performs the power move; the clause explains why it's odd instead of letting it sit odd.

issues.unit: Keiner sagte, was zwischen ihnen stand.
issues.fix_hint: Delete this sentence. Rutz's ambiguous nod two lines later already carries the unspoken weight; naming that something 'stood between them' explains the silence instead of trusting it.

issues.unit: Auf der Straße war es kalt geworden
issues.fix_hint: Cut 'kalt geworden' and 'farblos'. Stock weather does no work here; go straight from the cellar to 'Vor der Kirche stand Rutz.'

issues.unit: Der Fall Aebischer war abgeschlossen, wie der Fall Vogel abgeschlossen war
issues.fix_hint: Delete the final sentence. End on 'Im Blech der Schranktür... das Gesicht ohne Züge' — the distorted reflection already says the case is closed; restating it in ledger language flattens the image into a caption.

issues.unit: und keiner sah dem anderen nach
issues.fix_hint: Cut 'und keiner sah dem anderen nach'. Berta's 'Sie drehte sich nicht um' already established the not-looking-back gesture; repeating it on Stettler and Rutz explains the parting instead of just letting them walk off.
